column1: # ownership.tsv — the one-owner-per-datum ledger for the strict transliteration.
# TRACKED, R1-CLEAN. Like symbols.toml, this holds ONLY obfuscated identifiers
# and JVM type descriptors (structural facts) — never decompiled source.
# One row per Java STATIC field of a ported class. Static-ness is read from the
# `static` flag in `javap -p` on the baseline bytecode; reviewed field names come
# from java/reconstruction/symbols.toml. A Java static has exactly one persistent
# Rust owner (no second copy, no copy-in/copy-out): the *State struct + rust_name
# named here is that sole home. Instance fields of the singletons (GameMIDlet,
# GameLoop) are NOT static and are not listed here, but live on the same *State.
# obf class map (the obfuscated .class each java_class was recovered from):
#   GameMIDlet  -> rpg/GameMIDlet.class  (the only class outside the default package)
#   GameScreen  -> as.class   (PARTIAL: the geometry statics + the case-9 main-menu
#   Menu        -> cb.class   (no rows: the abstract menu base has NO static fields —
#                              every field is per-instance, carried by MainMenuState.base)
#   AssetCache  -> ce.class   (PARTIAL: the title/logo render-path statics + the
#   FontManager -> bh.class   (PARTIAL: the title text path's fonts + labels, plus the
#                              main-menu item labels + Ok/Exit soft-key labels)
#   BitmapFont  -> az.class   (no rows: no static mutable state — its `crcTable`
#                              is a `static final` constant, reproduced by a fn;
#                              a BitmapFont's data is per-instance, modelled by the
#                              per-font BitmapFontState the FontManager rows own)
#   WrapFont    -> b.class    (no rows: adds no fields — a WrapFont IS a BitmapFont)
#   PngMerger   -> br.class   (no rows: its `crc`/`adler` statics are the shared-
#   Directions  -> u.class    (interface of static-final constant tables → module
#                              consts; owner token is the `directions` module)
#   SaveCipher  -> bq.class   (no rows: pure static utility, no fields)
#   RmsFile     -> au.class   (no rows: instance class, no static fields)
#   EntityList  -> aq.class   (no rows: instance class, no static fields)
# Singleton note (extends the GameMIDlet/GameLoop instance-field note above):
# StringTable's one static `a:Lcj;` (`instance`) is eagerly `new StringTable()` at
# class load — the always-present singleton. Its Rust owner IS the StringTableData
# `localeIndex`, and the `locales` final array) live on StringTableData and, like
# the other singletons' instance fields, are not listed as separate rows.
# FontManager's six font fields are typed `b` (WrapFont); each is modelled by a
# object — so both map to the one Rust owner `big_black` (no second copy).
#   obf                 obfuscated field simple name (as in the bytecode)
#   rust_owner_struct   the *State struct that owns it
#   rust_name           the Rust field name on that struct
